physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the neocortex, the outer layer of the brain, the wrinkled grey sheet wrapped over everything older underneath. It is the newest part of the human animal and the part that does the most thinking, and it is also where the inherited weight sits. The fears that came in the blood do not float in the air around a person. They run as patterns in this tissue, repeating, looping, lighting up the same circuits the parents lit, and theirs before them.

The shadow has its bodily floor in that looping. A mind that cannot stop turning over the same predicament. Worry that sounds like thought but produces nothing. Heat behind the eyes from a brain that has been at it since before you were old enough to know it had started. The oppression is felt in the skull before it is felt anywhere else, a pressure pressing outward against the bone.

The climb out is bodily too, and unmistakable. The gaps between thoughts widen. The looping circuits go quiet for whole minutes at a time, then longer. The pressure behind the forehead lifts and is replaced by something almost spacious, the way a room sounds different after a fan has been switched off. The neocortex was not the enemy. It was the surface the inheritance had to be burned off of, one slow pass at a time, until what remained underneath could finally be heard.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Glycine. The body uses Glycine as the first ingredient when it makes heme, the molecule at the centre of red blood, the iron-bearing ring that lets the blood carry oxygen. Every red cell in you was started from this small letter.

There is a teaching in that, and it sits at the centre of this card. The code whose shadow is the weight carried in the blood runs on the chemistry that builds the blood itself. The ancestral load was never separate from the substance moving in your veins. It was made from the same letters. So is the way out. The same amino acid that lays down the inheritance also lays down the cells that will carry it forward, or carry it through.

The chemistry says what the card says, only lower. What looks like an inherited curse is the body's own writing, in a script the body knows how to revise. The code runs all the way to this: a karma kept in the blood, written in a letter the blood is still using, every hour, to make itself again.
